connections.title: Active connections
connections.subtitle: Review recently seen IP addresses and block one on its node when access is no longer yours.
connections.startingDescription: Opening a secure scan with the connection provider.
connections.scanDescription: Checking recent activity across every connection node.
connections.scanFailed: The provider could not complete this scan.
connections.emptyDescription: No recent IP addresses were reported for your subscription.
connections.blockDescription: Block {ip} on this node and disconnect its current sessions.
connections.sharedIpWarning: Other sessions sharing this public IP may also be interrupted.
connections.expiryWarning: This node-specific block expires automatically 72 hours after you submit it.
connections.unblockDescription: Remove the node-specific block for {ip} now.
connections.blocksEmpty: No IP addresses are currently blocked.

blockOperation.processing: The provider is blocking this IP before disconnecting it.
blockOperation.succeeded: The IP is blocked and its active connection was removed.
blockOperation.failed: The provider rejected the block and no active block was retained.
blockOperation.pending_review: The block outcome is unclear. The record remains until expiry for review.
blockOperation.partial: The IP is blocked, but the connection could not be fully reconciled.

unblockOperation.processing: The provider is removing this IP block.
unblockOperation.failed: The provider rejected the unblock request; the block remains active.
unblockOperation.pending_review: The unblock outcome is unclear. Automatic expiry remains scheduled.
unblockOperation.partial: Only part of the unblock operation completed.

errors.scanFailed: A connection scan could not be started.
errors.pollFailed: Connection progress could not be refreshed.
errors.blocksFailed: Active IP blocks could not be loaded.
errors.blockFailed: The block request could not be accepted.
errors.unblockFailed: The unblock request could not be accepted.
